translations.web: For now I have chosen and made this house holy, that my name may be there forever; and my eyes and my heart will be there perpetually.
translations.bsb: For I have now chosen and consecrated this temple so that My Name may be there forever. My eyes and My heart will be there for all time.
translations.kjv: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house, that my name may be there for ever: and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.
translations.asv: For now have I chosen and hallowed this house, that my name may be there for ever; and mine eyes and my heart shall be there perpetually.
